content: Rohan Deshmukh contacted insurance agent Karan Joshi to check on the cancellation status of his health policy (HP-2024-5678). Karan confirmed that the policy was cancelled as of yesterday with the 24-hour effective date applied. Rohan inquired about the prorated refund, and Karan confirmed it is being processed and will be credited to his bank account within 5 to 7 business days using the bank details already on file, requiring no additional documents.
